ideas.title: Harvest Storms for Cash ⛈️
ideas.hook: Plant crops that only grow when a storm hits them, then drag your field into the path of tornadoes, hail and lightning to grow rare storm plants.
core_loop: Plant seeds on your farm plot
Watch the forecast and move crops into the storm's path
Harvest storm-charged crops when the weather passes
Sell crops and fill the storm-plant index
Buy tougher seeds that need bigger storms
ideas.twist: Each storm type mutates crops differently: lightning makes glowing crops, hail makes crystal crops, but a direct tornado hit can rip your whole row away.
monetization: Luck pass for rare storm mutations
VIP plot with an extra field row
Storm summon (developer product) to call the next storm early
retention: Storm schedule with a rare super-storm every hour
Storm-plant index with rewards for each page
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm + Disaster / weather is the top gap in the data (score 5.57). Grow / farm is at 1.89 with Throw a Seed (38,578 CCU) and Disaster / weather is at 2.30 with Stop The Tsunami! (9,181).
ideas.differentiator: The weather is the growth engine, so the risky choice of where to put your field is the whole game.

ideas.title: Sketch Exits to Survive ✏️
ideas.hook: You're trapped in a dark school at night with a monster. Draw a door, ladder or hole on any wall with your chalk and it becomes real for a few seconds.
core_loop: Find chalk sticks around the building
Draw an exit shape on a wall or floor
Run through before the drawing fades
Reach the next floor and the next room
Escape the building to unlock new maps
ideas.twist: The monster can use your drawings too, so a door you leave behind can let it catch up.
retention: Co-op runs for up to 4 friends
ideas.why_now: Paint / create + Horror is a strong gap (score 4.99). Paint / create is at 1.67 with Draw Your Cart! (10,672) and Interiors are rising at 1.91, led by Suzy Says! [HORROR] (18,648).
ideas.differentiator: Drawing is your only way out, so every chase is a fast doodle under pressure instead of a fixed route.

ideas.title: Grow Balls for Trophies 🏆
ideas.hook: Grow sports balls on plants in your garden, then kick each one at a giant goal across a field. Rarer balls fly further and score bigger.
core_loop: Plant ball seeds on your plot
Harvest grown balls
Kick them at distance goals for coins
Buy better seeds and stronger boots
Unlock new fields with farther goals
ideas.twist: Balls keep growing while you wait, so you choose between kicking a small ball now or a huge heavy one later that is harder to aim.
monetization: Luck pass for rare golden balls
retention: Trophy index for every ball type
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm + Sports is an open gap (score 4.65). Grow / farm is at 1.89 and Hit / swing / launch is at 1.87 (up 0.43 this week), led by Throw a Seed (38,578) and Ragdoll Soccer (21,905).
ideas.differentiator: Farming and kicking are joined: what you grow is your ammo and your size choice changes your shot.

ideas.title: Grow Keys for Freedom 🔑
ideas.hook: Secretly grow key plants in your prison cell. Each rare key opens a new wing of the prison until you can break out.
core_loop: Plant key seeds under your bunk
Water them while guards aren't looking
Harvest keys and open locked doors
Grab better seeds from the new wing
Reach the final gate and escape
ideas.twist: Guards do cell checks on a timer, so you must hide or move your plants before they arrive or lose your crop.
monetization: VIP cell with a hidden stash
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm + Prison / police is a gap (score 4.08). Grow / farm is at 1.89 and Prison / police is at 1.30, with 13 Days to Escape [ALPHA] (9,254) and Prison Tycoon (5,833).
ideas.differentiator: A calm grow loop mixed with guard-check tension, so farming has real stakes.

ideas.title: Fish for Relics 🐊
ideas.hook: Cast into a desert river beside the pyramids and reel up ancient relics, golden statues and the odd angry crocodile.
core_loop: Cast into the river
Reel in relics and fish
Sell relics to the museum
Buy better rods and bait
Unlock deeper tomb pools
ideas.twist: Some relics are cursed: keep them and your luck rises, but a mummy starts following you until you sell it.
retention: Limited events with new relic sets
ideas.why_now: Fishing + Collect / index is a top new-game pair (15 new games, 96,336 CCU). Fishing is at 1.42 with [🐟] Fish For Sea Animals (32,813) and the "___ for ___" formula is at 1.83 (up 0.72 this week). Fishing + Ancient / pyramids is an open gap.
ideas.differentiator: An untouched setting for the hot fishing loop, plus the cursed relic risk choice.

ideas.title: Draw Mechs for Battle 🤖
ideas.hook: Draw your mech's legs, arms and weapons with limited ink, watch it come to life as a physics robot, then send it to fight other players' drawings.
core_loop: Draw a mech body with your ink
Attach weapon parts you have unlocked
Fight another mech in a short physics match
Win ink upgrades and parts
Draw bigger, stronger mechs
ideas.twist: Whatever you draw is exactly how it moves, so a wobbly leg means a wobbly mech.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create + Robots / mechs is a gap (score 3.66). Paint / create is at 1.67 with Draw Your Cart! (10,672), Robots / mechs is at 1.72 with Mechs vs Kaiju's Ragdoll | [MAJOR UPDATE] (11,697), and Physics Sim is the top subgenre at 2.59.
ideas.differentiator: Your own drawing is the fighter, so no two mechs look or fight the same.

ideas.title: +1 Torch Light 🏺
ideas.hook: Every step you take inside the pyramid makes your torch +1 brighter. Brighter light lets you go deeper, find treasure and scare off mummies.
core_loop: Walk the pyramid halls to raise your light
Enter darker chambers as your light grows
Grab treasure in each chamber
Rebirth for light multipliers
Reach the pharaoh's tomb
ideas.twist: Mummies can only move in the dark, so the edge of your light is where the danger is.
ideas.why_now: The "+1 ___" formula is at 1.48 with [🧬] +1 Venom Evolution (9,456) and [W3] +1 Scary Evolution (5,841). Interiors are rising at 1.91, and +1 stat + Ancient / pyramids is an open gap.
ideas.differentiator: The stat you grow is also how much of the map you can see, so progress is visible every step.

ideas.title: Stunt Cars Over Volcanoes 🌋
ideas.hook: Floor it off a ramp and launch your car over an erupting volcano. Land it to cash in, or crash into lava and watch it fall apart.
core_loop: Pick a car and drive at the ramp
Launch over the volcano
Earn cash for distance and landing
Upgrade engine, boost and armour
Unlock bigger volcanoes
ideas.twist: Each eruption throws lava rocks into the air, so the right timing can bounce you further or smash your car mid-flight.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch + Race / drive is the top new-game pair (12 new games, 100,442 CCU). Disaster / weather is at 2.30, Physics Sim at 2.59 and Vehicle Sim at 1.56, led by BloxNG [CRASH PHYSICS] 💥 (23,482).
ideas.differentiator: The disaster is the course: eruptions change every jump, so no two runs land the same way.

ideas.title: Chip Giants for Gold 🗿
ideas.hook: Giant stone golems walk across the land. Climb onto them with your pickaxe and chip off ore chunks before they shake you off.
core_loop: Wait for a giant to spawn
Climb on and mine ore from its body
Dodge its swipes and stomps
Sell ore and upgrade your pickaxe
Take on bigger, rarer giants
ideas.twist: Mining the giant's weak spots makes it angrier but drops rarer ore, so greedy players risk getting flung for the whole server.
monetization: Grip pass to stay on longer
retention: Giant index with every golem type
Server boss giants on a timer
ideas.why_now: Break / mine / dig + Fight / battle is a top pair (8 new games, 80,073 CCU). Break / mine / dig is at 1.51 (up 0.11), and Giant / huge is at 1.74 with Mechs vs Kaiju's Ragdoll | [MAJOR UPDATE] (11,697). Low poly art is rising at 1.63.
ideas.differentiator: The mine is a moving boss, so mining turns into a shared climb-and-hold fight.

ideas.title: Build a Meteor Dome ☄️
ideas.hook: Build a dome over your base block by block, then survive the meteor shower. Whatever is still standing after the strike earns you cash.
core_loop: Collect blocks and cash
Build your dome and shelter
Survive the meteor shower round
Earn rewards for surviving parts
Unlock stronger materials
ideas.twist: Meteors leave space crystals in craters, so players must run out of their domes mid-shower to grab them.
ideas.why_now: Sandbox is at 1.95 and Physics Sim at 2.59. Space is the top theme at 2.35 and Disaster / weather is at 2.30, with Build Your World! 🔨 (21,625) and Stop The Tsunami! (9,181) proving build-then-survive works.
ideas.differentiator: Building and surviving are one test, and the crater crystals pull players out of safety.
